China's top medical equipment manufacturers include Mindray, United Imaging Healthcare, MicroPort, Lepu Medical, Shinva Medical, Edan Instruments, Wego Group, Neusoft Medical, Yuwell Medical, and Snibe. These market leaders supply advanced imaging, patient monitors, and surgical tools worldwide. [](https://www.bkamed.com/top-10-medical-equipment-manufacturers-in-china/)

- **Mindray:** Patient monitors, diagnostic ultrasound, and life support systems.

- **United Imaging:** High-end medical imaging like PET/CT, MRI, and advanced X-ray scanners.

- **MicroPort:** Cardiovascular stents, pacemakers, and orthopedic surgical implants.

- **Lepu Medical:** Cardiac pacemakers, vascular intervention devices, and diagnostic testing.

- **Shinva Medical:** Medical sterilizers, digital X-rays, and surgical operating tables.

- **Edan Instruments:** Patient monitors, ECG diagnostic machines, and point-of-care testing.

- **Wego Group:** Single-use medical consumables, orthopedic materials, and infusion pumps.

- **Neusoft Medical:** CT scanners, MRI systems, and digital ultrasound equipment.

- **Yuwell Medical:** Home-use healthcare devices like blood pressure monitors, oxygen concentrators, and wheelchairs.

- **Snibe (Shenzhen New Industries Biomedical Engineering):** Chemiluminescence immunoassay diagnostic analyzers and laboratory reagents. [](https://www.bkamed.com/top-10-medical-equipment-manufacturers-in-china/)
